      "snippet": "Short answer: yes—but only if it is done in a very specific, constrained way.

The Truth (No Fluff)
Creating a world-class prompt at the end of every message would help only if it is:

Machine-consumable

State-aware

Non-interactive by default

Bounded by governance

Integrated into the Inchworm + SandCrawler flow

If it’s just a “nice prompt suggestion,” it becomes noise and actually reduces fidelit"
